ov-cat-mouse-tell.note: mouse-tell (D3): eyes open + amber locked gaze tracking the offered mouse + tail-tip flick; body stays settled. Two patches (eyes + tail) so the Developer can flick the tail on a separate beat. eye seam 3.2, tail seam 2.9.

ov-cat-slow-blink.note: slow-blink half-lid (9.1 slow blink): 0.52 open / 0.48 closed blend over the eye band; the refusal/contentment tell. seam 3.2.

ov-cat-tail-flick.note: tail-tip flick (PIL upward shear); tail half of the tell / idle. seam 2.9.
